the current training model in Singapore does not adequately address the role of theory.

(1) the concept of theory as application is not a useful one for understanding the role of theoretical knowledge in teacher education, and (2) the concept of application is not an appropriate metaphor for understanding how pre service teachers should use their theoretical knowledge in practice.

the question, how can theory be made to serve better the purposes of teacher preparation?
the nature of theory and its role in teacher preparation.
the nature and role of theory in the training of teachers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the role of theory is to provide pre service teachers with a broad and deep understanding of what teaching is, and what it means to be a teacher.
the concept of theory-application is not a good one for teacher preparation.
the current training model in Singapore, which is based on the concept of theory applications, is inadequate to meet the demands and needs of the teaching profession.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
theory application should be understood in a more complex and sophisticated way than the current model allows.

the current model of teacher preparation is inadequate in that it does not sufficiently prepare teachers to meet the challenges of the classroom, and that a more holistic model of teacher education needs to be adopted.
theory application in the current training programme is problematic and should be rethought in order to better prepare pre service teachers to become well informed professionals.
The main takeaway from our work is that
theory is not only a tool for teachers to learn how to do things, but more importantly a tool for them to learn how to think about what they are doing.
the concept of theory in education should not be understood in a narrow sense, but as a complex and multi-faceted concept that is essential to the preparation of teachers.
theory is an important resource for teacher preparation and it needs to be understood and used in a more complex way than is currently being done in teacher preparation.
